params.body:
Reporter: Ilse (dealer team), mail of 17 September 2026. On Beheer > Dealers the button "Inloggen als een gebruiker van <dealer>" did not work for a dealer with more than one user; she had to open the dealer, tab Werknemers, and log in per user. Her ask: with several users, log in as one who already accepted the terms (Garage Denutte: Steffi, not Mathy).

## Root cause

With several dealer administrators the row rendered an Alpine menu of names. That menu is `position: absolute` inside the table's `overflow-x-auto` wrapper, which clips it. A dealer found by search is the last (only) row, so the panel opened out of sight and the click looked dead. Reproduced locally (`before-last-1440-after-click.png`: a sliver of the panel under the last row). A second gap: the button only listed users with the `ownuser` edit right, so a dealer without such a user had no button at all.

## What changed

- The dealer row is one button whatever the number of users, "Inloggen als <naam>" in the tooltip. It links to `dealer/{id}/enter` (`dealer.index.enter`, named under `dealer.index` like `user.index.loginas` so the access middleware reads the menu right), handled by `DelegationController::enter`.
- `Delegation::pickTarget()` / `candidates()`: the active users of the dealer who are not platform administrators, ordered: accepted the terms first, then the dealer's administrator (`ownuser` right), then the most recently changed user record (a last login is not stored), then the highest id. Nobody accepted: same order, and the delegation bar shows the quiet "terms pending" notice from PR 505; no blocking modal.
- The notice after entering names the pick, and when there was a choice, out of how many: "Je werkt nu als Steffi Demaeght, gekozen uit 2 gebruikers van Garage Denutte. Alles wat je wijzigt wordt vastgelegd." (`delegation.started_picked`, nl/fr/en/de; `refused_no_user` for a dealer without an active user; the unused `row_enter_pick` is gone).
- `HomeController::index` now `reflash()`es the session: the start page is itself a redirect for module-1 dealers and every message flashed onto it ("Je werkt nu als ...", "Je bent terug in je eigen account") died on that hop. This is why the notice never appeared before.
- Rule R P2-11.8 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/32-p2-mijn-garage.md`, decision `klant:beslissingen#inloggen-als-kiest-een-gebruiker` with Ilse's sentence.

## Tests

`DelegationTest`: the row is one button for one and for two users and none without users; the pick order (accepted, dealer admin, most recently changed; platform admin and inactive user never candidates); entering a dealer with two users picks the one who accepted and says so, and the flash survives the home redirect; nobody accepted picks the latest and the bar says pending, no modal; one user unchanged; a dealer without users is refused with the reason; 403 for a non-administrator. Ran DelegationTest, TermsAcceptanceTest, DealerAuthorizationTest, RulesCoverageTest, RulesIdentityTest, RulesSourcesTest, LanguageParityTest, AlpineExpressionTest, HandlerWiringTest, CompiledViewsTest, StylesheetSyntaxTest and the SmokeTest route inventory: OK (66 tests, 1140 assertions, 1 incomplete pre-existing).

Hot file touched: `tests/Feature/SmokeTest.php`, one line (the new route named in the inventory of id routes).
params.title: Working as a dealer: the button picks a user who accepted the terms
